# idcardtools

> idcardtools offers online PDF and image tools, along with E-Aadhaar PVC card printing information.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://idcardtools.com/): E-Aadhaar PVC card printing and online document tools.
- [PDF tools](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools): Free PDF tools for merging, splitting, compressing, converting, and editing documents.
- [Image tools](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools): Online image conversion and editing tools.
- [Blog](https://idcardtools.com/blog): Guides and updates about PDF tools, document privacy, and E-Aadhaar PVC cards.
- [About](https://idcardtools.com/about): Information about idcardtools.
- [Contact](https://idcardtools.com/contacts): Contact and service information.
- [Privacy policy](https://idcardtools.com/privacy): Privacy information.
- [Terms](https://idcardtools.com/terms): Terms of service.

## Popular PDF tools

- [Merge PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/merge)
- [Compress PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/compress)
- [Split PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/split)
- [PDF to Word](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/pdf-word)
- [JPG to PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/jpg-pdf)
